holderQuote: Sixth? Inkar stared. But then—this was Deskie. The [Magic Spinner]. The one who had made Inkar—
A murmur of surprise from the other two Chieftains. Inkar’s brows rose. She stopped listening and told Deskie.

Inkar had hoped to go into the main Meeting of Tribes, which was already bustling that night, but she’d been asked to keep Deskie, the [Magic Spinner] who was so important and Inkar’s friend, company.
Oor scrambled to his feet. He ran past Deskie as the old [Magic Spinner] tsked. But then she smiled.
Deskie, the [Magic Spinner], Pulsg, the chief [Shaman]
Pisces murmured to the old [Magic Spinner] as Satar slowly wrote down Ksmvr’s full title
